svg.title: Isochrones by mode from Praça do Derby, Recife metropolitan region
svg.desc: Four maps of central Recife and its neighbours, one per mode, each shading the areas reached from Praça do Derby within 15, 30 and 45 minutes. Walking reaches the neighbourhoods around the square, 15 square kilometres in 45 minutes; cycling 44; driving with free-flowing traffic fills the map; walking plus public transport, at the morning peak of Tuesday 10 November 2026, reaches 108 square kilometres, in arms along the bus corridors and the metro lines.

g.text: Land reached within 15, 30 and 45 minutes. Public transport: buses, metro and VLT, the median
of the departures 07:00–07:59 on Tuesday 10 November 2026; within 45 minutes it reaches 108
km², cycling 44, walking 15. Dashed: municipal boundaries and the coast
Isochrones from Praça do Derby, Recife, by mode
